common.metaDescription: Create a beautiful, source-grounded learning playground from your course materials.

errors.generation-off: Course creation is not available right now. Please try again later.
errors.too-large: The material is larger than 4 MB of text. Remove a file.
errors.bad-request: Something in the request was not valid. Check your options and try again.
errors.wrong-code: The access code is not correct.
errors.daily-limit: Today's limit has been reached. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.not-found: We could not find this page.
errors.wrong-state: This can only be changed while the outline waits for review.
errors.bad-outline: Keep at least one lecture; titles can have at most 120 characters.
errors.course-too-big: This course is too large to finish. Try fewer or shorter files.
errors.plan-failed: We could not plan this course. Please try again.
errors.lecture-failed: We could not write this lecture. Please try again.
errors.busy: The service is busy. Please try again in a minute.
errors.material-gone: The uploaded material is no longer available.
errors.step-failed: This step failed. Please try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

materials.empty: Add at least one file with readable text.
materials.too-many-pages: Use at most {max} pages in total (you have {count}).
materials.too-long: The text is too long: {count} characters, at most {max}.
materials.scanned: This material looks scanned — it has almost no readable text.
